declarations.name: AuiRadioGroup
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI RadioGroup: `<aui-radio-group>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Legend text and accessible name of the radiogroup.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the legend; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Native radio name; a unique name is generated when absent.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Group help text referenced by the radiogroup's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: A selection is required (aria-required on the radiogroup, native required on radios).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the selection invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user selected an option (click, Space, or arrow keys).

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the selection changes.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the selected radio, else the first enabled radio.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial selection and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native radios sharing one name inside <fieldset role="radiogroup"> + <legend> (WAI-ARIA APG Radio Group, native keyboard model).

limitations: Once a radio is selected the user cannot clear the selection (native behavior); offer an explicit "None" option if needed.
Radios with the same consumer `name` in the same form form one native group, even across RadioGroup instances.
